reportedIssues: The second card in "Popular right now" shows a promo badge reading "-0%", which represents a zero discount and looks like a data/formatting bug.

The favorite (heart) buttons are styled inconsistently: the Tokumaru Ramen card uses a white circular button with a dark outline heart, while the pizza card below uses a dark/transparent circle with a white heart, making it look broken and reducing contrast against the light pizza image.

In the "Fastest near you" carousel the third card is hard-clipped at the screen edge and its title renders as "Trattoria Piccol" with no ellipsis, so it reads as truncated/broken text rather than scrollable content.
The category filter chip row is also clipped mid-chip at the right edge with no fade or partial-chip indication, so users may not realize more categories exist.
The bottom pizza card is cut off by the fixed bottom navigation bar; its name, rating and metadata are hidden and the image is sliced abruptly right at the nav divider.

The Green Bowl Poké thumbnail has a near-white background while its neighbouring cards use dark imagery, and its "15–25 min" badge sits on a very light area, giving the row an inconsistent, unfinished look.
Icon-only controls (notification bell, heart/favorite buttons, search icon) have no visible text labels; if accessible names are missing they will be unusable with screen readers.
